source: Draft checklist for a new adjuvant-treatment-plan visit (stage III colon cancer). Topics drawn from: ASCO Patient-Clinician Communication consensus guideline (Gilligan et al., J Clin Oncol 2017;35:3618-3632, PMID 28892432); SPIKES bad-news protocol (Baile et al., Oncologist 2000); NCCN Colon Cancer guideline (adjuvant section; current version not checked); ASCO/IDSA outpatient fever and neutropenia guideline (Taplitz et al., J Clin Oncol 2018). All items UNVERIFIED.

items.label: Asked what the patient knows and wants to know
items.description: Before giving results, clinician asks what the patient already understands and how much detail they want.
example_questions: What have you been told so far?
How much would you like me to explain?
items.guideline_ref: ASCO Patient-Clinician Communication consensus guideline (Gilligan et al., J Clin Oncol 2017;35:3618-3632, PMID 28892432); SPIKES steps P and I (topic source, unverified)
items.verification_note: Topic is taken from the cited source, but the recommendation text was NOT read line by line and the item is NOT clinician-reviewed. Not in the source as a numbered rule; drawn from its core-skills section and SPIKES.

items.label: Diagnosis and stage explained
items.description: Clinician states the diagnosis and stage in plain words.
example_questions: Here is what the pathology showed...
items.guideline_ref: SPIKES step K; ASCO Patient-Clinician Communication consensus guideline (Gilligan et al., J Clin Oncol 2017;35:3618-3632, PMID 28892432) (topic source, unverified)
items.verification_note: Topic is taken from the cited source, but the recommendation text was NOT read line by line and the item is NOT clinician-reviewed.

items.label: Goal of treatment
items.description: Clinician says what the treatment is for (here: lower the chance the cancer comes back).
items.guideline_ref: ASCO Patient-Clinician Communication consensus guideline (Gilligan et al., J Clin Oncol 2017;35:3618-3632, PMID 28892432) (topic source, unverified)
items.verification_note: Topic is taken from the cited source, but the recommendation text was NOT read line by line and the item is NOT clinician-reviewed.

items.label: Treatment, schedule and where it is given
items.description: Regimen name, how often, how long, where, and what goes home with the patient.
example_questions: How often, for how long, and where?
items.guideline_ref: NCCN Colon Cancer guideline, adjuvant therapy for stage III (CAPEOX or FOLFOX, about 3 to 6 months by risk) (topic source, unverified)
items.verification_note: Topic is taken from the cited source, but the recommendation text was NOT read line by line and the item is NOT clinician-reviewed. Duration by risk was seen only in secondary summaries; check the current NCCN version.

items.label: Common side effects
items.description: Clinician names the common side effects, including nerve symptoms (numbness, tingling) with oxaliplatin.
example_questions: What side effects should you expect?
items.guideline_ref: NCCN Colon Cancer guideline; oxaliplatin neuropathy reported in IDEA trial summaries (topic source, unverified)
items.verification_note: Topic is taken from the cited source, but the recommendation text was NOT read line by line and the item is NOT clinician-reviewed. Neuropathy rates seen only in secondary summaries.

items.label: When and who to call
items.description: Clinician says which signs (fever of 100.4 F / 38.0 C or higher, bleeding, vomiting) need an immediate call or emergency visit, and the number to use.
example_questions: What temperature means call us right away?
items.guideline_ref: ASCO/IDSA outpatient management of fever and neutropenia (Taplitz et al., J Clin Oncol 2018, DOI 10.1200/JCO.2017.77.6211) (topic source, unverified)
items.verification_note: Topic is taken from the cited source, but the recommendation text was NOT read line by line and the item is NOT clinician-reviewed. Fever thresholds (38.3 C single, 38.0 C sustained) seen in search summaries of the guideline; patient wording is from a provincial fever card.

items.label: Other options, trials, second opinion
items.description: Clinician mentions alternatives (for example another regimen or length), clinical trials and the option of a second opinion.
items.guideline_ref: ASCO Patient-Clinician Communication consensus guideline (Gilligan et al., J Clin Oncol 2017;35:3618-3632, PMID 28892432): patients should be made aware of all treatment options, including clinical trials (topic source, unverified)
items.verification_note: Topic is taken from the cited source, but the recommendation text was NOT read line by line and the item is NOT clinician-reviewed.

items.label: What matters to the patient
items.description: Clinician asks about work, family and priorities, and sets the plan around them.
example_questions: What matters most to you in the next months?
items.guideline_ref: ASCO Patient-Clinician Communication consensus guideline (Gilligan et al., J Clin Oncol 2017;35:3618-3632, PMID 28892432): shared agenda-setting and values (topic source, unverified)
items.verification_note: Topic is taken from the cited source, but the recommendation text was NOT read line by line and the item is NOT clinician-reviewed.

items.label: Support and cost of care
items.description: Clinician names who will help (nurse navigator, social work) and raises cost.
example_questions: Who can help with scheduling, costs or rides?
items.guideline_ref: ASCO Patient-Clinician Communication consensus guideline (Gilligan et al., J Clin Oncol 2017;35:3618-3632, PMID 28892432): cost of care and support (topic source, unverified)
